title: L² height of μ about the plane of an affine approximation of the graph
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} any set, R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), ξ ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, T an n-dimensional subspace, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 and ιv ∈ T for all v, w, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ |v − w| for all v, w, c ∈ ℝᵏ, Λ : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ continuous linear, t > 0 and h₀ ≥ 0. Put τ := ξ + ι'c, S := LinearMap.range(ι + ι'∘Λ) = {ιw + ι'Λw : w ∈ ℝⁿ}, Φ(v) := ξ + ιv + ι'f(v), F := Φ(ℝⁿ). Assume θ(x) = R.mult x = 1 for μ-a.e. x ∈ B_t(τ), and |(x − ξ) − p_T(x − ξ)| ≤ h₀ for every x ∈ spt μ ∩ B_t(τ) (closed balls). Then dim S = n (Module.finrank ℝ S = n), and (∫_{B_t(τ)} |(x − τ) − p_S(x − τ)|² dμ) ≤ (1 + n·2ⁿ)·(∫_{B̆ⁿ_t(0)} |f(v) − c − Λv|² dv) + (h₀ + |c| + ‖Λ‖t)²·μ(B_t(τ) ∖ F). Here the off-graph term (h₀ + |c| + ‖Λ‖t)²·μ(B_t(τ) ∖ F) is added outside the parameter-ball integral and outside its coefficient 1 + n·2ⁿ. All integrals are lower integrals of ENNReal.ofReal, constants enter as ENNReal.ofReal, B̆ⁿ_t(0) is the open ball of ℝⁿ, and ‖Λ‖ is the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (U : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (c : Euclid k) (Λ : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k) (t h₀ : ℝ), 0 < t → 0 ≤ h₀ → Module.finrank ℝ T = n → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v, ι v ∈ T) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ closedBall (ξ + ι' c) t → R.mult x = 1) → (∀ x ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall (ξ + ι' c) t, ‖(x - ξ) - T.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ≤ h₀) → Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Λ.toLinearMap)) = n ∧ (∫⁻ x in closedBall (ξ + ι' c) t, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - (ξ + ι' c)) - (LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Λ.toLinearMap)).starProjection (x - (ξ + ι' c))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + n * 2 ^ n) * (∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) t, ENNReal.ofReal (‖f v - c - Λ v‖ ^ 2)) + ENNReal.ofReal ((h₀ + ‖c‖ + ‖Λ‖ * t) ^ 2) * R.measure (closedBall (ξ + ι' c) t \ range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)))
